name: Leedarson IoT Technology Inc.
summary: Leedarson IoT Technology Inc. engages in the research and development, production, and sale of Internet of things (IoT) products, LED bulbs, fixtures, luminaires, light sources, and other products. The company provides sensors, controls, cameras, and smart appliances; smart lighting products; home security products, such as alarms, smoke alarms, water leakage alarms, video surveillance, and other products; energy management solutions; smart campus solutions; and home appliance solutions including air purifiers, fresh fans and AC, humidifiers, dehumidifiers, aromatherapy machines and other products.
